n: Aspen Digital Interpreting AI in the News lesson
t: A media literacy lesson on spotting hype and personification in AI news writing.
steps: Find the Interpreting AI in the News lesson from Aspen Digital and download it.
Choose the Word or Google Docs version.
Read the instructions and the vocabulary guide.
Choose two or three news articles about AI to use in class.
Use the assessment guidelines to plan how to grade the work.
